No observational or empirical consequences are represented or claimed.

Research-workflow metadata (provenance_note, target, domain, claims, obligations, literature) lives in the sidecar research_metadata.json, not in this manifest (the GR manifest schema has no fields for them; see PROTOCOL_GAPS.md). Claim statuses there remain metadata, not artifact-enforced state.
